Woman Allegedly Attempts Attack on Mamata Banerjee Outside Residence

A woman allegedly abused and attempted to attack West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee outside her Kalighat residence. The Trinamool Congress (TMC) alleged that the incident, which occurred as Banerjee was returning from a Durga Puja pandal inauguration, was a knife attack bid and a conspiracy planned by the BJP. The TMC stated that 'Even a 3-time CM is not safe.'
